# Hugging Face

> > The leading platform for machine learning collaboration, hosting models, datasets, and applications with tools like Transformers, Optimum, and the Hugging Face Hub.

Hugging Face is the AI community's home for sharing and deploying state-of-the-art machine learning models, including LLMs like Llama and Mistral, vision-language models, and specialized tools for evaluation, training, and deployment. The platform serves researchers, developers, and organizations building AI applications across natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, and more.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Hugging Face Hub
- Transformers library
- Model evaluation and benchmarking
- Vision-language models
- LLM deployment and optimization
- AI agents and tool calling
- Multilingual NLP
- Model fine-tuning and training
- NVIDIA and Intel hardware acceleration
- Open LLM Leaderboard
- Llama and Mistral models
- Synthetic data generation
- Reinforcement learning
- Content moderation and safety

## Model Releases and Announcements

- [Welcome the NVIDIA Llama Nemotron Nano VLM to Hugging Face Hub](https://huggingface.co/blog/nvidia/llama-nemotron-nano-vl): NVIDIA Llama Nemotron Nano VL vision-language model release on Hub
- [Falcon-Arabic: A Breakthrough in Arabic Language Models](https://huggingface.co/blog/tiiuae/falcon-arabic): TII's Falcon-Arabic language model announcement and benchmarks
- [Welcoming Llama Guard 4 on Hugging Face Hub](https://huggingface.co/blog/llama-guard-4): Meta's Llama Guard 4 multimodal content moderation model release
- [SmolVLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model trained on Lerobot Community Data](https://huggingface.co/blog/smolvla): SmolVLA vision-language-action model for robotics with Lerobot data
- [Visual Document Retrieval Goes Multilingual](https://huggingface.co/blog/vdr-2b-multilingual): vdr-2b-multi-v1 multilingual visual document retrieval model release

## LLM Evaluation and Benchmarking

- [The Hallucinations Leaderboard, an Open Effort to Measure Hallucinations in Large Language Models](https://huggingface.co/blog/leaderboard-hallucinations): Hallucinations Leaderboard for measuring LLM factuality and faithfulness
- [Back to The Future: Evaluating AI Agents on Predicting Future Events](https://huggingface.co/blog/futurebench): FutureBench benchmark for evaluating AI agents on future event prediction
- [Open LLM Leaderboard: DROP deep dive](https://huggingface.co/blog/open-llm-leaderboard-drop): Deep dive analysis of DROP benchmark in Open LLM Leaderboard
- [🇵🇭 FilBench - Can LLMs Understand and Generate Filipino?](https://huggingface.co/blog/filbench): FilBench benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Filipino language understanding
- [How good are LLMs at fixing their mistakes? A chatbot arena experiment with Keras and TPUs](https://huggingface.co/blog/keras-chatbot-arena): Chatbot arena experiment evaluating LLM error correction with Keras/TPUs

## Model Deployment and Optimization

- [Optimize and deploy with Optimum-Intel and OpenVINO GenAI](https://huggingface.co/blog/deploy-with-openvino): Guide to optimize and deploy models with Optimum-Intel and OpenVINO GenAI
- [Hugging Face Text Generation Inference available for AWS Inferentia2](https://huggingface.co/blog/text-generation-inference-on-inferentia2): TGI deployment guide for AWS Inferentia2 with SageMaker integration
- [Easily Train Models with H100 GPUs on NVIDIA DGX Cloud](https://huggingface.co/blog/train-dgx-cloud): Tutorial for training models with H100 GPUs on NVIDIA DGX Cloud
- [Accelerating Protein Language Model ProtST on Intel Gaudi 2](https://huggingface.co/blog/intel-protein-language-model-protst): ProtST protein language model optimization for Intel Gaudi 2 accelerators

## AI Agents and Advanced Techniques

- [License to Call: Introducing Transformers Agents 2.0](https://huggingface.co/blog/agents): Transformers Agents 2.0 framework for LLM agents and tool calling
- [KV Cache from scratch in nanoVLM](https://huggingface.co/blog/kv-cache): KV cache implementation tutorial for autoregressive generation in nanoVLM
- [Cosmopedia: how to create large-scale synthetic data for pre-training Large Language Models](https://huggingface.co/blog/cosmopedia): Cosmopedia synthetic dataset creation for LLM pre-training methodology
- [Keep the Tokens Flowing: Lessons from 16 Open-Source RL Libraries](https://huggingface.co/blog/async-rl-training-landscape): Comparative analysis of async training in 16 open-source RL libraries

## Specialized Applications

- [Patch Time Series Transformer in Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/blog/patchtst): PatchTST for time series forecasting with transfer learning capabilities
- [Hugging Face partners with TruffleHog to Scan for Secrets](https://huggingface.co/blog/trufflesecurity-partnership): TruffleHog partnership for automated secret scanning in repositories
